Name: Cypher's Shed and Carriage House - (CP) and (AT)
Author: Genomecypher
Description:
I love carriage houses so I wanted to make it a retexture option for the shed. This mod retextures the shed and big shed to match my other mods. It uses the same retexture for both the shed and big shed but you are able to use both designs at the same time (one for shed and a different one for the big shed) using GMCM for the CP version or you can use the AT version to change at will.

There are 4 colors for now but I still plan on eventually adding ability to recolor at Robin's in all my mods. There are 3 roof options for the carriage house and 2 for the shed. Extra winter decorations and leaves can be turned off.
